title: Beach Please | KEY.co
description_expanded: Each of the three king bedrooms offers plush accommodations with Smart TVs, while the fourth bedroom features full bunk beds for added versatility. The outdoor spaces are equally enticing, with a private heated pool, ample seating, and a grill for alfresco dining. With pet-friendly amenities, complimentary bikes, and the convenience of a washer and dryer, this home offers all the comforts of home in an elegant seaside setting. Perfect for groups of up to 10, this property ensures every detail is covered for a seamless and unforgettable stay. This four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bathroom beach house is a coastal haven, perfectly designed for relaxation and connection. Nestled in the heart of 30A, it boasts a private pool and is just a short stroll from Eastern Lake Beach Access, making it an idyllic retreat for families and groups seeking the ultimate beach getaway. The thoughtfully curated interiors include an inviting living area with a large Smart TV, a fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar, and a dining area perfect for sharing meals and memories.
